scope: Theorem 2.6 (Converse and sharpness) of the manuscript “The spacetime Penrose inequality with charge and original-data rigidity” (preprints/The-spacetime-Penrose-inequality-with-charge-and-original-data-rigidity-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 84ca5bc05bc907a1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 6. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let M > q q2 E + q2 B, and put R+ = M + q M2 − q2 E − q2 B. Every smooth spacelike exterior hypersurface of dyonic Reissner–Nordström with these parameters whose induced data satisfy Definitions 2.1 and 2.4, whose boundary is a full cross-section of the corresponding future horizon or its bifurcation sphere, and whose actual invariant ADM mass and outward charge fluxes are M, qE, qB, satisfies ag(S) = Areag(S) = 4πR2 + and attains equality in Theorem 2.3. For every such parameter triple there are admissible static examples, examples with K ̸≡ 0, and examples with nonzero ADM momentum.
